intro: Professionals and everyday users convert gallons (us) (gal (US)) to fluid ounces (us) (fl oz) when working across us_customary and us_customary standards in culinary recipe scaling, beverage bottling, laboratory reagent preparation, and fluid tank capacity sizing. One gallon (us liquid) equals 128 fluid ounces (us), while 1 fluid ounce (us) equals 0.007813 gallons (us). Whether you are verifying volume & liquid specifications on imported equipment, cross-checking technical datasheets, or scaling practical measurements, this converter applies the exact NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 reference relationship with instant precision.

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: US Customary vs. British Imperial Liquid Volume Trap
items: US Customary and UK Imperial liquid units share identical names but have different physical volumes: 1 US Gallon is 3.78541 L (128 US fl oz), whereas 1 UK Imperial Gallon is 4.54609 L (160 Imp fl oz) — a 20.1% difference.

Similarly, 1 US Pint contains 16 US fluid ounces (473.18 mL), while 1 British Imperial Pint contains 20 Imperial fluid ounces (568.26 mL). Always verify whether your recipe, pump datasheet, or vehicle spec sheet uses US or UK standards.

faqs.question: How many fluid ounces (us) (fl oz) are in 1 gallon (us liquid) (gal (US))?
faqs.answer: There are 128 fluid ounces (us) (fl oz) in 1 gallon (us liquid) (gal (US)), which rounds to 128 fl oz for everyday calculations. Conversely, 1 fluid ounce (us) equals 0.007813 gallons (us).

faqs.question: How do I convert gallons (us) to fluid ounces (us) (gal (US) to fl oz)?
faqs.answer: To convert gallons (us) to fluid ounces (us), use the formula: fl oz = gal (US) × 128. For example, converting 5 gal (US) gives 640 fl oz.

faqs.question: What is 5 gallons (us) in fluid ounces (us)?
faqs.answer: 5 gallons (us) (gal (US)) equals exactly 640 fluid ounces (us) (fl oz) using standard NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 conversion factors.
